# echov4ult

> Chris Retherford's personal project universe: AI crews, creator tools, games,
> practical kits, and build-in-public notes. EchoVault, LLC publishes finished
> tools and honest receipts from the work at echov4ult.com.

Flagship product: Full Party — The AI Game Studio Kit. 10 specialist agents
(Studio Director, Game Director, Art Director, Lead Engineer, Code Reviewer,
QA Director, Quality Critic, Player Advocate, Narrative Designer, Marketing
Strategist), 5 governance documents, 30 documented workflows, 22 slash commands,
27 templates. Two editions: Claude Code (full integration with installer) and
Universal Prompt (any AI assistant). Works with any game engine: Godot, Unity,
Unreal, custom, or none. Tiers: Demo Pack $0, Creator $49 (1 person), Studio
$129 (up to 5 people). Installer verified by a 22/22-scenario acceptance suite.

- [Full Party product page](https://echov4ult.com/full-party/): full contents, tiers, FAQ
- [Operator's Kit product page](https://echov4ult.com/operators-kit/): 8 session-discipline skills for Claude Code, tiers, FAQ
- [Launch Crew product page](https://echov4ult.com/launch-crew/): an AI marketing department for Claude Code (unofficial) — 6 agents + 4 playbooks, drafts-only by design, tiers, FAQ
- [Multi-agent Claude Code: the practical guide](https://echov4ult.com/guides/claude-code-multi-agent-setup/): role design, governance, party size, acceptance testing
- [The AI game development workflow](https://echov4ult.com/guides/ai-game-development-workflow/): concept → pillars → proposals → QA gates → release check
- [Blog](https://echov4ult.com/blog/): build-in-public notes with real numbers
- [Why I rebuilt echov4ult as a project universe](https://echov4ult.com/blog/why-i-rebuilt-echov4ult-as-a-project-universe/): the new site's design decisions, mistakes, tools, and quality gates
- [What my AI crew actually shipped this month](https://echov4ult.com/blog/what-my-ai-crew-shipped-this-month/): a dated receipt trail across products, publishing, ViralLens, and the site rebuild
- [ViralLens](https://echov4ult.com/virallens/): an active creator-calibration lab
- [V4ULT RUN](https://echov4ult.com/game.html): a playable browser game
